752:t_3:87.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Besides, isn't it a thrill? To see out the end of the ambitions of those $$御使い$$s... no, of $$アドヴェント#pilot$$, who went even beyond them.」

752:t_3:88.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「You are a man beyond saving.」

752:t_3:90.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「So it seems. I have been made to realize that more than enough.」

752:t_3:92.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「This is farewell, $n. Just as you all told me, even if I searched every world, there seems to be no place for me.」

752:t_3:93.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「So, from outside the natural order, allow me to watch the universe welcome a new era.」

752:t_3:95.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「You have no need to forgive me.」

752:t_3:98.en:
$n
「From here on, over a long span of time, humanity will surely evolve, and go through $$シンカ$$... Someday it may even become a higher-dimensional life form...」

752:t_3:99.en:
$n
「But it will never become the kind of being that rules over anyone's fate or life.」

752:t_3:100.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「If that is the future you have chosen, I, who am departing, have nothing to say.」

752:t_3:101.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I will only bestow my blessing on the future of you who overcame the obstacle that was me.」

752:t_3:102.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Right up to the very end, you look down on everyone...」

752:t_3:103.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Shall we go, $$ジ・エーデル・ベルナル$$? The man who tried to become a god and the man who was called a devil will make their exit here.」

752:t_3:104.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Goodbye, $n. And please give my regards to everyone, too.」

752:t_3:105.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「A world where both gods and devils have vanished... What remains there is humanity.」

752:t_3:106.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「May happiness be upon your future!」

752:t_3:109.en:
$n
「If this is a world with neither gods nor devils, then let's decide for ourselves where it is headed...」

753:t_000:0.en:
$$スズネ$$
「$$エス・テラン$$ is in pieces!」

753:t_001:0.en:
$$赤木$$
「Did it break apart from the shock back then!?」

753:t_001:1.en:
$$カレン$$
「Where did $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ go!?」

753:t_001:2.en:
$$シンジ$$
「Didn't he go down along with $$エス・テラン$$...?」

753:t_001:3.en:
$$刹那$$
「That's too much to hope for...! Here they come!」

753:t_002:0.en:
$$葵$$
「The $$御使い$$s' servants are still around!」

753:t_002:1.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「So the forces that had been dispatched to other worlds have come back!」

753:t_002:2.en:
$$真徒$$
「What a disaster! $$エス・テラン$$ has been destroyed!」

753:t_002:3.en:
$$真徒$$
「Oh...! Lord $$ドクトリン$$, Lord $$アドヴェント#pilot$$, Lord $$サクリファイ$$, Lord $$テンプティ$$!」

753:t_002:4.en:
$$真徒$$
「Please guide us...! Guide us, for we are lost!」

753:t_002:5.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
(There is no need to worry.)

753:t_002:8.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
(I promise eternity... That is the duty of the $$御使い$$s, and it is my duty.)

753:t_002:9.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
(But there are those who would destroy that eternity.)

753:t_002:10.en:
$$真徒$$
「We understand! It is them, isn't it!」

753:t_002:11.en:
$$真徒$$
「Leave it to us, Lord $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! We will exterminate the Earthlings!」

753:t_002:14.en:
$$ガロード$$
「If you keep doing whatever the $$御使い$$s tell you, the whole universe is going to end!」

753:t_002:15.en:
$$真徒$$
「Inferior species! How could the likes of you understand the will of the Exalted Ones!」

753:t_002:16.en:
$$真徒$$
「That is nothing but the howling of those who were not chosen! You are pitiful losers who can never reach eternity!」

753:t_002:17.en:
$$ロラン$$
「The $$御使い$$s you believe in were annihilated by $$アドヴェント#pilot$$!」

753:t_002:18.en:
$$レド$$
「Even $$エス・テラン$$ was destroyed by $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! And you still believe him!?」

753:t_002:19.en:
$$真徒$$
「The salvation of all universes shall come at the hands of the emissary of the Supreme God!」

753:t_002:20.en:
$$真徒$$
「Chant the words of salvation! Salus!」

753:t_002:21.en:
$$シン$$
「It's no use...! Words can't reach these guys anymore!」

753:t_002:22.en:
$$アムロ$$
「We'll break through them and head for $$エス・テラン$$! $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ has to be there!」

753:t_002:23.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「All units, begin the attack! We take down the $$真徒$$s and stop $$アドヴェント#pilot$$!」

753:t_002:24.en:
$$甲児$$
「If we don't defeat him, the great collapse of the universe will happen...!」

753:t_002:25.en:
$$タケル$$
「Far from stopping the great collapse, he talked as if he were waiting for it!」

753:t_002:26.en:
$n
「We have to hurry...! Otherwise every universe will come to an end!」

753:t_003:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
「It's him...! It's definitely $$アドヴェント#pilot$$!」

753:t_003:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「The time of rebirth has come. Now the bells of blessing ring out loudly.」

753:t_003:3.en:
$n
「What are you going to do, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$!?」

753:t_003:4.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「The Heavenly Prison has been destroyed... Here, a new universe heralds its beginning.」

753:t_004:0.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Distortion of the dimensional boundary line confirmed. However, it is a pattern entirely different from any observed so far.」

753:t_004:2.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Unable to predict. All sensors have completely lost function.」

753:t_005:0.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I detect a tremendous surge of $$次元力$$! It far exceeds that of $$プロディキウム$$ or $$シュロウガ$$!」

753:t_007:0.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「H-huge doesn't even begin to describe it!」

753:t_007:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Yes. This is hope and salvation descended... the new Supreme God.」

753:t_007:4.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「And this is the land where the old world ends and the new world begins... In other words, the star at the end of myth.」

753:t_007:5.en:
$$勝平$$
「A star!? You mean that busted-up $$エス・テラン$$!?」

753:t_008:1.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「But there's no $$スヴェル$$!」

753:t_008:2.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「It consumed so much $$次元力$$ that its operating limit arrived sooner than expected!」

753:t_008:3.en:
$$五飛$$
「A world where $$エス・テラン$$ and our Earth exist at the same time...!」

753:t_008:4.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「What on earth is happening!?」

753:t_008:5.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$カオス・コスモス$$ and $$エス・テラン$$ have collapsed. Yes... the Heavenly Prison has vanished.」
